short_description: Germany-based artificial-intelligence and market-intelligence software company founded in 2010 by Pascal Lauria that operates publicly as Cogia AG following a 2021 listing on the Düsseldorf stock exchange. Cogia's stated strategic priority is to consolidate a fragmented European market for text- and data-analytics tooling by using public equity as acquisition currency. Cogia AG is the listed vehicle into which the original operating company Cogia Intelligence GmbH was merged.
